4000.name: The Foothills
4000.description:
The area is a path leading north, small hills surround you. You feel the
forces of evil approach you from the north. Off in the distance to the
northeast Visible is the beginning of a large mountain range. Rocks jut
from the grassy slopes. The view stretches for miles in every direction.

north.description: A rocky path climbs toward The Hills

south.description: To the south lies In The Western Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies A Scraggly Trail.

4001.name: The Hills
4001.description:
The area is a small path leading north, dark threatening hills surround
you on almost all sides. A fair distance off to the north, Visible is
the enormous shadow of a strangely solitaire mountain. Rocks jut from
the grassy slopes. The wind carries the scent of wild herbs.

north.description: A rocky path climbs toward The End Of The Path

south.description: A rocky path climbs toward The Hills

4002.name: At The Entrance To A Cave
4002.description:
The path gives out at the foot of a lone, steep-sided mountain, and a
narrow trail scrambles on through tumbled boulders to the black mouth of
a cave in its north face. Cold air breathes out of the opening, smelling
of wet stone. Grey hills crowd around in a threatening ring, their
grassy flanks broken by outcrops of rock. East, the land climbs into the
mountains proper, while the path winds back south down among the hills.

north.description: An open path leads to The Cave

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: A rocky path climbs toward The Hills

4010.name: The Cave
4010.description:
This is a small cave, about fifteen feet across at the widest point and
about forty feet long. Off to the south you sense fresh air and you
surmise that the entrance must be located off in that direction. To the
north a small tunnel continues into the mountain. The air is fresh and
clean. Wildflowers dot the landscape.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

south.description: A rocky path climbs toward The End Of The Path

4011.name: The Tunnel
4011.description:
You force your way into a narrow tunnel, aided by the wet walls which
help you slide through the passageway. The smell of mouldy moss is
growing greater the farther north you head, but you can smell fresh air
off to the south as a light breeze wafts past you. Ancient trees rise on
all sides. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

south.description: An open path leads to The Cave

4012.name: The Tunnel
4012.description:
The passage opens at a turn in this narrow tunnel. The tunnel appears to
open up to the north into a cave of some sort while to the east it leads
onwards through the mountain. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.
The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

north.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4013.name: The Tunnel
4013.description:
Standing in the middle of the dusty floor of this tunnel, Visible is
that it is not a highly travelled passageway. It looks to lead in an
east-west direction. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.
The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4014.name: The Tunnel
4014.description:
The passage opens at a small intersection of sorts in this tunnel. The
main tunnel appears to curve from south to west but there is an entrance
into a cave to the north. The entrance itself looks to be unnatural and
much more recent than the tunnel or even the cave. Bird calls echo
through the canopy. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

north.description: An open path leads to The Cave

south.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4015.name: The Tunnel
4015.description:
You clamber on through this narrow tunnel. The walls are damp with
condensation and the weight of the rock above is beginning to make
you feel almost claustrophobic. The tunnel makes a jagged turn from west
to north here. The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Branches
intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4016.name: The Large Cave
4016.description:
The passage opens in a fairly large cave. Large enough that the eastern
and western ends are almots completely shrouded in darkness. A small
tunnel breaks through the southern wall, and it too is full of shadows.
The open sky stretches overhead. The air is fresh and clean.

east.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

south.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

4017.name: The Large Cave
4017.description:
You move along the cave to the west end of it and find that there
appears to be no other exit from here. The walls are fairly smooth and
look to have been naturally carved out of the rock by the passage of
water. Wildflowers dot the landscape. The ground is soft underfoot.

west.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

4018.name: The Cave
4018.description:
The passage opens at the southern end of a cave as it begins to turn
into a tunnel which leads off to the south. The cave continues
northwards deeper into the darkness. You notice a large pile of bones in
the corner. The ground is soft underfoot. Wildflowers dot the landscape.

north.description: An open path leads to The Cave

south.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4019.name: The Tunnel
4019.description:
The area opens in the middle of a fairly wide passageway that leads in a
north-south direction. The walls are quite smooth, almost as if a river
had gouged them out of the earth. Ancient trees rise on all sides. The
scent of pine and earth fills the air.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Many Tunnels

south.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4020.name: The Hole
4020.description:
This is a small alcove off the main tunnel. There is a fairly wide hole
broken through the floor of the alcove. The only other exit is to the
north. The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Branches intertwine
overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

down.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4021.name: The Hole
4021.description:
As you stand at the end of this tunnel, you notice a large hole sitting
in the floor by the northwestern corner of the walls. The tunnel itself
leads off towards the east. The air here feels very damp and you feel
like your clothes are becoming sticky with sweat. The scent of pine and
earth fills the air. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Damp Tunnel

down.description: A trail winds toward The Dark Passage

4022.name: The Damp Tunnel
4022.description:
This is the middle of a damp tunnel. The moisture in the air is so thick
that you can almost seem it seeping into your clothes. The tunnel
continues to the north and west. A large cave opens up to the east. Bird
calls echo through the canopy. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen
leaves.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Damp Tunnel

east.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

west.description: A trail winds toward The Hole

4023.name: The Large Cave
4023.description:
This is the western part of the large cave, to the east Visible is a
tunnel. The air near the tunnel entrance is heavy with moisture, giving
you a feeling as if you were standing in the rain. The walls of the cave
are almost totally shrouded in darkness and shadow as is the southern
end of the cavern. The air is fresh and clean. Tall grass sways in a
gentle breeze.

east.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

west.description: A trail winds toward The Damp Tunnel

4024.name: The Damp Tunnel
4024.description:
The tunnel you are in now is very humid, and the air seems to almost
hang with moisture. The walls drip with an almost constant water flow,
and the ground is covered with small pools of stagnent water. The tunnel
leads away to the south, and to the west you can feel that the air is
even damper than here. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the
light. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

south.description: A trail winds toward The Damp Tunnel

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4025.name: The Cave
4025.description:
The passage opens standing in the northern end of a reasonably large
cave. The cave wall to the east has an opening that appears to lead to a
junction of several tunnels. The air is fresh and clean. Wildflowers dot
the landscape.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Many Tunnels

south.description: An open path leads to The Cave

4026.name: The Many Tunnels
4026.description:
The passage opens standing in the midst of an intersection of numerous
tunnels. There is a musty smell emanating from the tunnel to the north,
whilst the one to the west appears to open up almost immediately into a
cave. The tunnels to the south and east are totally shrouded in
darkness. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Ancient trees
rise on all sides.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Smelly Tunnel

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

south.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: An open path leads to The Cave

4027.name: The Tunnel
4027.description:
The passage opens at an elbow turn in the tunnel as it turns to the west
and north. You spot a small alcove hidden in the shadows just to the to
the south, and you can feel a breeze coming from somewhere to the north
you believe. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Bird calls
echo through the canopy.

north.description: An open path leads to The Cave

south.description: A trail winds toward The Hole

west.description: A trail winds toward The Many Tunnels

4028.name: The Smelly Tunnel
4028.description:
This is a fairly small north-south leading tunnel. There is a a small
light visible off to the north. As you stop for a moment, you notice a
strange smell from the north. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.
Ancient trees rise on all sides.

north.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

south.description: A trail winds toward The Many Tunnels

4029.name: The Cave
4029.description:
This is a cave that is filled with fresh air, you sense the wind blowing
from the north. To the south you see a small tunnel continue into the
mountain. The open sky stretches overhead. The air is fresh and clean.

north.description: An open path leads to The Valley

south.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4030.name: The Light Cave
4030.description:
This is a light cave, through a hole large above, you see the sky. A
small tunnel to the south is the only way out. You notice the source of
the strange smell, all around there are corpses of several monsters.
Tall grass sways in a gentle breeze. The ground is soft underfoot.

south.description: A trail winds toward The Smelly Tunnel

4031.name: The Valley
4031.description:
This is a small valley, surrounded by hills and a mountain to the south.
In the mountain there is a cave. To the north you can enter the hills.
There is a small trail leading up a steep hill to the east. Tall grass
sways in a gentle breeze. Wildflowers dot the landscape.

north.description: A rocky path climbs toward The Foothills

south.description: An open path leads to The Cave

4032.name: The Foothills
4032.description:
The area is a winding path that leads through the foothills on the north
side of Mount Moria. The path continues north. The terrain rolls and
dips around. Sheep trails wind between the hillocks.

north.description: The Intersection In The Foothills

south.description: An open path leads to The Valley

4033.name: The Intersection In The Foothills
4033.description:
The area opens at a point by a small path that splits off here. The path
continues north and south while a rough trail leads east into the
mountains. Sheep trails wind between the hillocks. The terrain rolls and
dips around.

north.description: An open path leads to The Grassy Area In The Foothills

east.description: A rocky path climbs toward The Path Through The Foothills

south.description: A rocky path climbs toward The Foothills

4034.name: The Grassy Area Of The Foothills
4034.description:
The grass here is unusually high. You notice several areas where someone
or something large has crushed spots of it down. Several very large
rocks litter this area. You can go north towards the end of the
foothills, west to go deeper into the foothills, or south to a small
path intersection. The ground is soft underfoot. Wildflowers dot the
landscape.

north.description: A rocky path climbs toward At The Foothills' End

south.description: The Intersection In The Foothills

west.description: An open path leads to The Level Foothills

4035.name: The Foothills End
4035.description:
The passage opens standing at the northern edge of the foothills where
they meet the plains which lie to the north. You can head back into the
foothills to the south or the plains to the north. Sheep trails wind
between the hillocks. The terrain rolls and dips around.

south.description: An open path leads to The Grassy Area In The Foothills

west.description: To the west lies The Copse of Trees.

4037.name: The Foothills Path
4037.description:
The area opens on a path that leads through the foothills in an east-
west direction. Some distance off to the west Visible is a small
intersection of paths and off to the east you see that the path seems to
come to an end as part of the mountain chain juts out of the ground,
blocking your view of the sky. The terrain rolls and dips around. The
view stretches for miles in every direction.

east.description: A steep trail ascends to The Base Of The Mountain

south.description: To the south lies A Small Path In The Foothills.

west.description: The Intersection In The Foothills

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Mountains.

4038.name: In Front Of The Huge Mountain
4038.description:
The passage opens standing at the bottom of a large mountain in the
mountain chain which begins at Mount Moria and stretches north towards
the top of the world. A small path leads off through the foothills
towards the west, where Visible is plains quite a ways away. To the east
you spot a small worn trail leading up the side of the mountain. Snow
clings to shadowed crevices. The air is thin and cold at this altitude.

west.description: A rocky path climbs toward The Path Through The Foothills

4042.name: The Level Foothills
4042.description:
You continue to move through the foothills and notice that off in the
distance to the west, Visible is a rather large cave entrance in the
side of a large hill. The hill seems to jut up from the rest of the
foothills quite unnaturally. A path leads off towards the east as it
seems to begin from nothing here. The ground is soft underfoot.
Wildflowers dot the landscape.

east.description: An open path leads to The Grassy Area In The Foothills

west.description: An open path leads to The Cave Entrance

4043.name: The Cave Entrance
4043.description:
The area opens in a large tunnel, much larger than it seemed from the
outside. The ceiling is at least twenty feet above, and the width of the
tunnel runs at least fifteen feet. You can feel the fresh air coming
from the east, and off to the west, it looks to lead into darkness. The
open sky stretches overhead. Wildflowers dot the landscape.

east.description: An open path leads to The Level Foothills

west.description: An open path leads to The Hill Giant Cave

4044.name: The Hill Giant Cave
4044.description:
The passage opens inside a rather large cavern. The ceiling stands at
least twenty five feet above, if not more. The walls are so far away,
that the shadows of the room obscure them almost completely. Out of all
of the grandeur in this cave however, nothing seems to catch your eye
quite as much as the enormous table standing in the middle of the sandy
floor. It stands tall enough for you to walk under it without the need
to hunch over. A large tunnel leads out of the eastern wall of the
cavern. Tall grass sways in a gentle breeze. The open sky stretches
overhead.

east.description: An open path leads to The Cave Entrance

4050.name: The Tunnel
4050.description:
This is a bend in the tunnel here. It turns from an eastwards heading to
a southwards one. The walls are cold and seem to be damp with moisture.
Visible is some greenish moss growing up near the roof of the passageway
on the northern wall. A collapsed section to the north looks recently
cleared. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Branches
intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

4051.name: The Tunnel
4051.description:
Standing in this part of the tunnel, you notice that not only does the
tunnel get suddenly narrower, but the floor does not seem to be nearly
as smooth as it was before. In fact, the floor drops almost five feet in
jagged steps as you look eastward. The western path seems to be quite
smooth however. Ancient trees rise on all sides. Bird calls echo through
the canopy.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies None.

4052.name: The Tunnel
4052.description:
Continuing along the tunnel, you find that the floor has begun to smooth
itself out once more. Looking about, you notice a small spring of water
bubbling up near the southern wall. Branches intertwine overhead,
filtering the light. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4053.name: The Tunnel
4053.description:
You continue along the tunnel to find yourself at a right angle turn.
The passage leads north and east from here. The way to the north seems
to be a longer tunnel which continues on through the gloom of the
underearth. The way to the east is a fresh change from what would
normally be found this far underground in that the tunnel seems to open
up into a fairly large and well lit cave. Ancient trees rise on all
sides. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

east.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

4054.name: The Light Cave
4054.description:
The cave you stand in now is lit by an eerie flickering light, which
probably comes from the enormous fire which is burning a short distance
to the south in what looks to be the middle of the cave. The flickering
light creates some really strange and almost frightening shadows on the
walls, almost hiding the two tunnels that lead away from here, one to
the east and one to the west. Wildflowers dot the landscape. The open
sky stretches overhead.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Maze

south.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4055.name: The Maze
4055.description:
The area opens in yet another small and damp tunnel. The ceiling hangs
quite low overhead and the passage twists off into darkness. The only
exit from here looks to be off to the west. The forest floor is carpeted
with fallen leaves. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

west.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

4056.name: The Light Cave
4056.description:
The cave you stand in now is lit by an eerie flickering light, which
comes from the enormous fire which is burning right ahead in the middle
of this large cave. The fire gives off more than enough light to see
both the north and south ends of the cave. Wildflowers dot the
landscape. Tall grass sways in a gentle breeze.

north.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

west.description: To the west lies The Maze.

4059.name: The Tunnel
4059.description:
This is a tunnel deep inside the heart of Mount Moria. A small rivulet
of water runs alongside the wall to the north as the tunnel seems to
lead slightly down towards the east. The tunnel continues on to the east
as it plunges deeper into the earth, and upwards a bit towards the west
where the air seems to be quite damp. The forest floor is carpeted with
fallen leaves. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4060.name: The Tunnel
4060.description:
The area opens in a section of this small tunnel which seems to be
almost level. There is a small pool of water collecting beside the north
wall indicating perhaps a low spot on the floor. The pool is being fed
by a small rivulet which is coursing along the northern wall from the
west, but yet the water level in the pool does not seem to be changing.
Looking either way down the tunnel, Visible is that the tunnel climbs to
the west, and to the east, a strange flickering light shows that the
tunnel opens up into a cave of sorts. Branches intertwine overhead,
filtering the light. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

east.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4061.name: The Light Cave
4061.description:
The cave you stand in now is lit by an eerie flickering light, which
probably comes from the enormous fire which is burning a short distance
to the north in what looks to be the middle of the cave. The flickering
light creates some really strange and almost frightening shadows on the
walls, almost hiding the two tunnels that lead away from here, one to
the west and one to the south. The open sky stretches overhead. The
ground is soft underfoot.

north.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

south.description: A trail winds toward The Maze

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4062.name: The Maze
4062.description:
The area opens in yet another small and damp tunnel. The ceiling hangs
quite low overhead and the passage twists off into darkness. The only
exits from here look to be off to the east and west. Ancient trees rise
on all sides. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Maze

4063.name: The Maze
4063.description:
The area opens in yet another small and damp tunnel. The ceiling hangs
quite low overhead and the passage twists off into darkness. The only
exits from here look to be off to the east and north. The scent of pine
and earth fills the air. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen
leaves.

east.description: To the east lies The Light Cave.

4064.name: The Tunnel
4064.description:
The area opens in a small chamber beneath the earth. The chamber closes
down to tunnel size to the west as the only obvious exit leads away in
that direction. Before heading off that way, you decide to look around
the cave. The walls are slightly damp to the touch, and the ceiling is
very smooth. Almost right in the centre of the ceiling, a well rounded
hole has been made. The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Ancient
trees rise on all sides.

west.description: To the west lies The Light Cave.

up.description: A trail winds toward The Hole

4065.name: The Maze
4065.description:
The area opens in yet another small and damp tunnel. The ceiling hangs
quite low overhead and the passage twists off into darkness. The only
exits from here look to be off to the east and north. To the north, you
can see the entrance to what looks to be a large and well lit cave. Bird
calls echo through the canopy. The scent of pine and earth fills the
air.

north.description: An open path leads to The Light Cave

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Large Cave.

4066.name: The Maze
4066.description:
The area opens in yet another small and damp tunnel. The ceiling hangs
quite low overhead and the passage twists off into darkness. The only
exits from here look to be off to the east, south, and north. To the
south, the tunnel looks to open up into a cavern. Branches intertwine
overhead, filtering the light. The scent of pine and earth fills the
air.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Maze

east.description: A trail winds toward The Maze

south.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

4067.name: The Maze
4067.description:
The area opens in yet another small and damp tunnel. The ceiling hangs
quite low overhead and the passage twists off into darkness. The only
exits from here look to be off to the west and north. Ancient trees rise
on all sides. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

west.description: A trail winds toward The Maze

4068.name: The Large Cave
4068.description:
The passage opens in what is perhaps the largest cave you have ever been
in. It stretches through the darkness to the east and south. The cave is
nigh filled with echoes created by the sound of your breathing.
Stalactites and stalagmites hang down from the ceiling and climb upwards
from the ground of the cavern respectively. The open sky stretches
overhead. The air is fresh and clean.

east.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

south.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

4069.name: The Large Cave
4069.description:
The passage opens in what is perhaps the largest cave you have ever been
in. It stretches through the darkness to the west and south. The cave is
nigh filled with echoes created by the sound of your breathing.
Stalactites and stalagmites hang down from the ceiling and climb upwards
from the ground of the cavern respectively. A narrow tunnel leads away
from the cave to the north. The air is fresh and clean. The open sky
stretches overhead.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Maze

east.description: To the east lies The Maze.

south.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

west.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

4070.name: The Large Cave
4070.description:
The passage opens in what is perhaps the largest cave you have ever been
in. It stretches through the darkness to the east and north. The cave is
nigh filled with echoes created by the sound of your breathing.
Stalactites and stalagmites hang down from the ceiling and climb upwards
from the ground of the cavern respectively. A faint draft carries a
metallic tang from the east. The open sky stretches overhead. The ground
is soft underfoot.

north.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

east.description: To the east lies The Large Cave.

4071.name: The Large Cave
4071.description:
The passage opens in what is perhaps the largest cave you have ever been
in. It stretches through the darkness to the west and south. The cave is
nigh filled with echoes created by the sound of your breathing.
Stalactites and stalagmites hang down from the ceiling and climb upwards
from the ground of the cavern respectively. A narrow tunnel leads away
from the cave to the east. The open sky stretches overhead. The air is
fresh and clean.

north.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

4072.name: The Tunnel
4072.description:
The area opens in a narrow tunnel. It makes a turn from east to south
here as it heads through the rock of the mountain. The western wall of
the tunnel looks to have broken through a small, natural crack in the
rock to lead into what appears to be a fairly large cave. The scent of
pine and earth fills the air. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen
leaves.

north.description: To the north lies The Maze.

east.description: A trail winds toward The End Of The Tunnel

south.description: A trail winds toward The Hole

west.description: An open path leads to The Large Cave

4073.name: End Of Tunnel
4073.description:
The tunnel comes to a sudden halt here. How very bizarre. The only exit
is back to the west, where the tunnel leads back through the mountain.
There is absolutely nothing of any interest down at the end of this
passageway either. How odd. Bird calls echo through the canopy. The
scent of pine and earth fills the air.

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4074.name: The Hole
4074.description:
This is a small hole in the floor. Alas, you can only leave north
because to leave down into the unknown, you must be able to fit through
the hole, which is far too small for you! Ancient trees rise on all
sides. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

down.description: To the down lies Through The Rubble.

204075.name: A Small Path In The Foothills

north.description: To the north lies The Foothills Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn In The Path.

204075.description:
A small path, hardly more than a goat track, runs down between steep
grassy banks from the main foothills path. Stones poke through the turf
like knuckles, and the bracken on either side grows waist-high. North,
the path climbs to join a wider way through the foothills; south, it
slips toward a dark overhang where it turns beneath the rock.

204076.name: A Turn In The Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Path In The Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Mountain Trail.

204076.description:
The path turns here beneath a great shelf of rock, running through a
short natural tunnel whose walls are smoothed by wind and the brush of
passing shoulders. Daylight glows at both ends, grey to the north where
the small path climbs back toward the foothills, and brighter to the
east where the tunnel lets out onto the mountain trail. The air inside
is cool and still, and a soot-blackened niche in the wall shows where
travellers have sheltered from the weather.

4075.name: The Copse of Trees
4075.description:
Standing in this copse of trees gives you an eerie feeling. Off to the
east Visible is the plains, and just to the north a strange shadow seems
to be changing shape constantly and almost seems to beckon you to enter
it. Sheep trails wind between the hillocks. The terrain rolls and dips
around.

east.description: To the east lies The Foothills End.

4100.name: The Tunnel
4100.description:
As you continue along this tunnel which heads deeper and deeper into the
earth, you notice that the tunnel must be a lot steeper than you
previously expected as there is a small rivulet of water gushing down
the one side of the tunnel. The tunnel appears to extend straight to the
east for quite some distance. Pick marks on the west wall suggest a
hidden seam. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light. Bird
calls echo through the canopy.

west.description: To the west lies The Long Tunnel.

4101.name: The Long Tunnel
4101.description:
The tunnel seems to be slightly sloped here as it continues in its east-
west direction. The tunnel walls are far apart, almost allowing for four
people to travel abreast with ease. The walls do not seem to be very
damp, but there is a small rivulet running along the northern wall of
the tunnel. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Branches
intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Long Tunnel.

4102.name: The Long Tunnel
4102.description:
As you travel along this long tunnel, you begin to wonder just how long
it is. The walls are fairly far apart, but Visible is that they begin to
close in rather rapidly to the east. In fact, the manner in which they
come together almost reminds you of a funnel. Branches intertwine
overhead, filtering the light. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen
leaves.

east.description: To the east lies The Long Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Long Tunnel.

4103.name: The Long Tunnel
4103.description:
This is a long east-west tunnel. It is not all that wide at this point,
perhaps wide enough for two people to stand side by side without
impeding each other. Off to the west it appears that the tunnel opens up
some more while to the east it dives further down into the earth, and
Visible is a small hole about two feet in diameter about waist height in
the southern wall. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.
Ancient trees rise on all sides.

east.description: To the east lies The Long Tunnel.

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

west.description: To the west lies The Long Tunnel.

4104.name: The Long Tunnel
4104.description:
The passage opens in a small bulbous cavern ending. The somewhat
circular 'room' is about thirty feet in diameter and Visible is one exit
from it; a tunnel leading sharply upwards from the western wall. The
walls of this cavern are quite indistinct and you cannot see any moss or
dampness on them whatsoever. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.
Ancient trees rise on all sides.

east.description: To the east lies The Long Tunnel.

4105.name: The Golden Cave
4105.description:
This is what appears to be the north-east corner of this large cavern.
The cave is lit by the eerie, soft, golden light which looks to be
emanating from the walls themselves. The cave itself is enormous,
extending quite a distance to the west and south. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past. Buildings crowd together on all sides.

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

west.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

4106.name: The Golden Cave
4106.description:
This is what appears to be the north-west corner of this large cavern.
The cave is lit by the eerie, soft, golden light which looks to be
emanating from the walls themselves. The cave itself is enormous,
extending quite a distance to the east and south. There is a hole in the
northern wall, about two feet in diameter. All that can be seen through
the hole is darkness. The sounds of city life echo around you. Buildings
crowd together on all sides.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Long Tunnel

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

4107.name: The Passage
4107.description:
The area opens at the elbow turn of a small passageway. It turns quite
sharply to the south and west. To the south, it appears that the passage
continues, but to the west Visible is what almost appears to be a golden
light. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Bird calls echo
through the canopy.

south.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

west.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

4108.name: The Golden Cave
4108.description:
This is what appears to be the south-east corner of this large cavern.
The cave is lit by the eerie, soft, golden light which looks to be
emanating from the walls themselves. The cave itself is enormous,
extending quite a distance to the west and north. A crack in the wall to
the east appears to lead into a passageway of sorts. Buildings crowd
together on all sides. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

east.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

west.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

4109.name: The Golden Cave
4109.description:
This is what appears to be the middle of the western wall of this large
cavern. The cave is lit by the eerie, soft, golden light which looks to
be emanating from the walls themselves. The cave itself is enormous,
extending quite a distance to the east, south, and north. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past. Buildings crowd together on all sides.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

4110.name: The Hole
4110.description:
The passage opens standing in a small alcove as the tunnel comes to a
somewhat sudden end. Looking about you suddenly notice a rather big hole
in the floor of the tunnel. In fact, it seems that another step forward
and you would have fallen into it. The tunnel itself leads to the west,
and looking down into the hole in the floor reveals little beyond the
fact that it seems to be very deep and very dark. There is a very
strange smell emanating from the hole, it almost smells like something
down there is rotting. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.
Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4111.name: The Tunnel
4111.description:
The walls of this small tunnel are almost completely covered in a
strange orange moss that flakes off to the touch. The tunnel leads in an
east-west direction and the air within is very damp and very stagnant.
There is no detectable breeze at all but a strange smell emanates from
the east. There is a small, almost unnoticed hole in the southern wall.
Bird calls echo through the canopy. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Hole

west.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

4112.name: The Tunnel
4112.description:
The tunnel in which you currently stand is fairly wide (very wide
relative to almost all the other tunnels around here it seems) and yet
the air is quite damp. The walls have a thin coating of moisture upon
them which looks and feels somewhat oiley. The tunnel leads in an east-
west direction. The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Ancient trees
rise on all sides.

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

west.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

4113.name: The Passage
4113.description:
This north-south passageway looks to be a natural creation, except that
the walls looks to have been roughly hewn in order to smooth them a
somewhat to make passage easier. The walls still meander as the passage
makes its way deeper into the bowels of the earth. A bizarre shadow in
the eastern wall leads you to suspect that a small passage meets the
tunnel there. Ancient trees rise on all sides. The scent of pine and
earth fills the air.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

east.description: A trail winds toward The Tunnel

south.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

4114.name: The Golden Cave
4114.description:
This is what appears to be the south-west corner of this large cavern.
The cave is lit by the eerie, soft, golden light which looks to be
emanating from the walls themselves. The cave itself is enormous,
extending quite a distance to the north and a strange shadow formation
seems to indicate a passage entrance to the west. Buildings crowd
together on all sides. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

west.description: A trail winds toward The Dark Passage

4115.name: The Dark Passage
4115.description:
The passage opens in a small passage ending. It is quite dark in here.
As you look about the damp walls, you notice that the passageway almost
appears to curve upwards towards the ceiling. Looking up, you notice
that there is a small hole, just large enough to pass through. Looking
closely at the curved part of the wall, it appears that someone (or
something) has carved small handholds into the wall to ease passage
upwards. The tunnel itself leads off to the east. The forest floor is
carpeted with fallen leaves. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

up.description: A trail winds toward The Hole

4116.name: The Passage
4116.description:
The passage opens in quite an ordinary passageway which leads north and
south. It looks to be wide enough for two people to walk side by side
with plenty of room. The passage appears to be almost rectangular in
form. Far off to the south Visible is the pinpoint of a light. The
forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. The scent of pine and earth
fills the air.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

south.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

4117.name: The Secret Tunnel
4117.description:
The area is currently standing in a narrow passageway that does not seem
to have been heavily visited at any time. It leads northwards towards a
lit room and south towards what appears to be a chamber. The forest
floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Bird calls echo through the
canopy.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Golden Cave

south.description: A trail winds toward The Secret Chamber

4118.name: The Cave
4118.description:
This rather large cave is surprisingly very well lit. There are about
twenty torches spread about the room set in sconces which hang several
feet above your head. The dancing shadows created by the flickering
flames catch your eyes for a few minutes and threaten to hold you
entranced. Looking about the cave, it appears to continue to the west
and south. In the north wall a strange vertical crack looks as if it may
lead somewhere. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past. The cobblestones
are worn smooth by countless feet.

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

west.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

4119.name: The Cave
4119.description:
This rather large cave is surprisingly very well lit. There are about
twenty torches spread about the room set in sconces which hang several
feet above your head. The dancing shadows created by the flickering
flames catch your eyes for a few minutes and threaten to hold you
entranced. Looking about the cave, it appears to continue to the east
and south. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past. The smell of smoke and
humanity hangs in the air.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

west.description: The rock wall to the west looks odd for some strange reason.

4120.name: The Passage
4120.description:
The area opens in a fairly normal passage, slightly wider than is
necessary for one person, but not quite wide enough for two. The ceiling
dips here rather surprisingly, or wait, is that because the floor climbs
upwards toward it? The tunnel seems to narrow slightly more as you look
to the south, and widens up somewhat as you look northward. The light to
the south continues to flicker. Stone chimes hang from a fissure below.
Bird calls echo through the canopy. Branches intertwine overhead,
filtering the light.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

south.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

4121.name: The Secret Tunnel
4121.description:
The area opens in a very unnatural hallway, about ten feet across and
about ten or twelve feet up. The passageway funnels down towards the
west where it leads to a doorway that looks to be about five feet
across. The east end of the tunnel comes to a sudden end at a very
smooth rock wall. Bird calls echo through the canopy. Ancient trees rise
on all sides.

west.description: A trail winds toward The Secret Chamber

4122.name: The Secret Chamber
4122.description:
The area opens in a small chamber that you never would have thought
could exist. This small, almost perfectly round cave does not appear to
be a natural formation at all, since the walls are far too smooth and
the doorways to the north and east are both almost exactly five feet
wide and eleven feet tall. Bird calls echo through the canopy. The scent
of pine and earth fills the air.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Secret Tunnel

4123.name: The Cave
4123.description:
This rather large cave is surprisingly very well lit. There are about
twenty torches spread about the room set in sconces which hang several
feet above your head. The dancing shadows created by the flickering
flames catch your eyes for a few minutes and threaten to hold you
entranced. Looking about the cave, it appears to continue to the west
and north. The cobblestones are worn smooth by countless feet. Vendors
and pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

west.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

4124.name: The Cave
4124.description:
This rather large cave is surprisingly very well lit. There are about
twenty torches spread about the room set in sconces which hang several
feet above your head. The dancing shadows created by the flickering
flames catch your eyes for a few minutes and threaten to hold you
entranced. Looking about the cave, it appears to continue to the east
and north. There is a passageway leading out of the western wall of the
cave which looks to turn northwards. Vendors and pedestrians bustle
past. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

west.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

4125.name: The Passage
4125.description:
This is the end of a narrow passage which leads away from here to the
north. The southern wall is bare and almost seems to dance with the
shadows created by the flickering light emanating from the cave to the
east. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Bird calls echo
through the canopy.

north.description: A trail winds toward The Passage

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Cave

8506.name: On The Cliffside

up.description: To the up lies On The Cliffside.

down.description: To the down lies At The Plateau Before The Mountains.

8506.description:
A narrow shelf of grey rock clings to the face of the cliff, scarcely
wider than a man's shoulders, with handholds worn smooth by many
climbers. Below, the ledge drops back down to the broad plateau where
the mountains begin, and the Trade Road beyond it shrinks to a pale
thread. Above, the way climbs on up the cliff toward a lip of broken
stone where a smudge of smoke often hangs. The wind plucks at your
cloak, thin and bitterly cold.

8507.name: On The Cliffside

up.description: To the up lies Orc Lookout Camp.

down.description: To the down lies On The Cliffside.

8507.description:
Higher up, the ledge gives out and the climb goes on by a crooked
chimney in the rock, studded with iron spikes driven into its cracks.
The spikes are crusted with rust and bent by hard use, and crude marks
hacked into the stone beside them look like orc work. A reek of smoke
and rancid fat drifts over the lip of the cliff above, while below, the
chimney drops back to the narrow shelf. Far beneath your boots the
plateau lies spread out in the thin light.

8508.name: Orc Lookout Camp

east.description: To the east lies At The Edge Of The Cliff.

west.description: To the west lies At The Edge Of The Cliff.

down.description: To the down lies On The Cliffside.

8508.description:
The top of the cliff has been made into a squalid camp. A ring of
blackened stones holds a fire pit choked with ash and gnawed bones, and
a lean-to of stinking hides sags between poles jammed into cracks in the
rock. At the very lip a rickety platform of lashed timbers juts out over
the drop, giving a clear view of the plateau and the road far below. A
track follows the edge of the cliff east and west, and the spiked
chimney leads back down the face.

extra_descs.platform timbers lookout poles:
The platform is a crude thing of pine poles lashed together with
rawhide, its planks black with grease and creaking at every gust. Rows
of notches have been cut along one pole, a tally of something the
watchers here have counted on the road below.

8509.name: At The Edge Of The Cliff

east.description: To the east lies At The Edge Of The Cliff.

west.description: To the west lies Orc Lookout Camp.

8509.description:
The track runs along the very brink of the cliff, so close to the edge
that pebbles skitter away at every step and vanish without a sound.
West, the smoke and stink of the orc camp hang over the rocks; east, the
path keeps to the edge, hemmed in by a wall of frost-cracked stone on
its landward side. Tufts of wiry grass grow in the cracks, combed flat
by the endless wind.

8510.name: At The Edge Of The Cliff

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies At The Edge Of The Cliff.

8510.description:
Here the cliff edge bends away, and the track turns from the drop to
climb north into the mountains between two shoulders of bare rock. A
lightning-split pine clings to the stone at the turning, its dead limbs
bleached silver and its roots clawing at empty air. The way back west
follows the brink toward the orc camp, with nothing but cold space
between the path and the plateau below.

8511.name: At The Edge Of The Cliff

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies Orc Lookout Camp.

west.description: To the west lies At The Edge Of The Cliff.

8511.description:
Small cairns line the top of the cliff here, each one capped with a
scrap of filthy rag that snaps in the wind like a pennant. East, the
smoke of the orc camp rises beside its rickety lookout, and west the
path dwindles along the brink toward a lonely point. A rougher way
climbs north up the mountainside, away from the drop.

8512.name: At The Edge Of The Cliff

east.description: To the east lies At The Edge Of The Cliff.

8512.description:
The path ends on a jutting prow of rock with nothing beyond it but empty
air and a dizzying view. The wind is fierce here, and it has scoured the
stone so clean that not even lichen grows. Far below, the plateau and
the long grey line of the road lie open for miles. The only way back is
east along the brink.

8513.name: In The Mountains

south.description: To the south lies At The Edge Of The Cliff.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8513.description:
The mountainside slopes gently here before plunging over the cliffs
beyond, and the wind carries a faint smell of woodsmoke from somewhere
below. A low wall of piled stones, built by orcs or by older hands,
curves across the slope as a windbreak. The path runs south toward the
edge of the cliff and west across the scar of a rockslide.

8514.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

8514.description:
A rockslide has swept across the mountainside here, leaving a raw scar
of pale stone and splintered rock. The path has been trodden anew across
it, a narrow line of footholds between boulders that look ready to move
again. North, the way runs beneath a band of overhanging cliffs, and
east it heads toward the edge of the heights.

8515.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

8515.description:
Here the way squeezes along the foot of a band of cliffs, where the rock
overhangs so far that the ground beneath stays dry and dusty even in
rain. Old mud nests cling in rows under the overhang, long abandoned and
crumbling. The path leads east toward a high meadow with a dark tarn,
and south along the foot of the cliffs.

8516.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8516.description:
Tucked between the peaks lies a high meadow, where coarse grass and
cushions of moss grow among scattered boulders. A small tarn sits in the
middle, dark and perfectly still, mirroring the grey crags and the
clouds above them. The way runs north up a gravel slope and west toward
a band of cliffs.

8517.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

8517.description:
Loose, rust-coloured gravel covers this slope, and every footstep sends
a little rattling slide ahead of you. Clumps of saxifrage cling to the
larger stones, starred with tiny pink flowers. Clouds drift past close
enough to touch, wetting the stones as they go. The way climbs north
toward a glittering spring and descends south along the mountainside.

8518.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8518.description:
Several paths meet at this bend in the mountainside, where a spring
wells up from beneath a slab and spills down the rock in a glittering
sheet. The stone around it is slick with ice even on the mildest days.
North, a path heads toward the foot of a great cliff; south, another
winds down the slope; and west, a ledge runs across the mountain's face.

8519.name: In The Mountains

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

up.description: To the up lies Middle Of The Carved Stairs.

8519.description:
The path ends at the foot of a towering cliff, where an arched doorway
has been carved into the rock, framing the first steps of a stair that
climbs up into the heart of the mountain. Worn figures of bearded
warriors flank the arch, their faces eroded to smooth ovals. The only
other way leads south, back down the slope.

extra_descs.figures warriors arch carvings runes:
Each figure leans upon a great axe, and their beards are carved in long
braids that reach to their belts. Dwarven runes run around the arch
above them, worn so shallow that only fingertips can follow them now.

8520.name: In The Mountains

south.description: To the south lies At The Edge Of The Cliff.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8520.description:
Broken peaks crowd around a stony hollow here, their upper slopes
streaked with old snow that never quite melts. A path of trodden scree
comes up out of the south from the cliff edge and bends away west along
the foot of a crumbling ridge. The air is thin enough to make every
breath feel shallow, and somewhere among the rocks a trickle of
meltwater ticks and gurgles.

8521.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

8521.description:
A long tongue of scree spills down from the heights here, and the path
crosses it on stones that rock and grind underfoot. East, the way runs
back toward the stony hollow; north, it climbs a steepening gully choked
with boulders the size of huts. Lichen in rusty orange and pale green
crusts every surface the wind has not scoured clean.

8522.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

8522.description:
The gully narrows between walls of fractured grey stone, and the wind
funnels through it with a low, hollow moan. Old snow lies packed in the
deepest shadows, grey with grit and pitted by drips from above. A
stunted rowan has rooted itself in a crack, its few red berries bright
against the stone. The way climbs north over a jumble of fallen blocks
and drops back south toward the scree.

8523.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

8523.description:
The gully tops out on a windy saddle between two peaks, and for a moment
the whole range opens around you, ridge beyond ridge fading into blue
haze. The path turns east along the saddle toward the rim of a deep
cleft, while south it drops back into the gully. Snow cornices overhang
the higher ridges, carved by the wind into curls like breaking waves.

8524.name: In The Mountains

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

down.description: To the down lies The Illuminated Ravine.

8524.description:
The saddle ends at the rim of a deep, narrow ravine, and a strange pale
glow rises from its depths even in the full light of day. A rough stair
of ledges leads down into it, slick with seeping water. The path back
west follows the saddle between the peaks. Leaning over the rim, you
catch glints and sparkles far below, as if the ravine walls were sewn
with countless tiny lamps.

8525.name: The Illuminated Ravine

north.description: To the north lies The Illuminated Ravine.

up.description: To the up lies In The Mountains.

8525.description:
At the foot of the ledges the ravine floor is a bed of smooth grey
pebbles, and the walls on either hand are seamed with veins of milky
crystal. The crystals drink in the daylight and give it back as a soft,
steady glow, so that no shadow here is ever truly dark. The ravine runs
on north between its shining walls, and the wet ledges climb back up to
the saddle above.

extra_descs.crystal crystals veins vein:
The veins are a hand's breadth wide in places, a milky white crystal
shot through with threads of pale gold. Laid against the stone, your
palm feels a faint warmth, and the glow brightens a little beneath your
touch.

8526.name: The Illuminated Ravine

north.description: To the north lies The Illuminated Ravine.

south.description: To the south lies The Illuminated Ravine.

8526.description:
The ravine walls lean so close that only a ribbon of sky shows far
overhead, and here the crystal veins grow so thick that the stone itself
seems made of light. A soft white radiance fills the cleft from end to
end, throwing your shadow faintly in several directions at once. A thin
stream runs down the middle of the floor, and the ravine follows its
course north and south.

8527.name: The Illuminated Ravine

south.description: To the south lies The Illuminated Ravine.

up.description: To the up lies In The Mountains.

8527.description:
The ravine ends at a steep headwall where the stream spills down from
above in a thin, chattering fall. The crystal veins dwindle here to a
few faint threads, and a pale moss glows dimly in the spray. Wet
handholds lead up the rock beside the fall toward the open mountainside,
while the shining cleft stretches back south.

8528.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies Beside The Tooth Of The World.

down.description: To the down lies The Illuminated Ravine.

8528.description:
Above the ravine the ground opens onto a high, barren shelf where
nothing grows but black lichen. North, a colossal spire of dark rock
thrusts into the sky like a single fang, dwarfing every peak around it.
Behind you the waterfall's chatter rises from the ravine, where wet
handholds lead back down into the glow. Gusts come and go with sudden
violence, flinging grit across the stone.

8529.name: Middle Of The Carved Stairs

up.description: To the up lies Beside The Tooth Of The World.

down.description: To the down lies In The Mountains.

8529.description:
The stair winds upward inside the rock, each step cut with care and worn
into a hollow at its middle by the passage of countless feet. Narrow
slits cut through the outer wall let in thin blades of daylight and a
whistle of cold wind. Carvings along the walls show ranks of bearded
figures climbing toward a great tooth of stone. The stair climbs up
toward the open air and winds down toward the mountainside below.

8530.name: Beside The Tooth Of The World

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies The Old Cave.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

down.description: To the down lies Middle Of The Carved Stairs.

8530.description:
The Tooth Of The World towers overhead, a fang of black stone so tall
that clouds snag on its tip and stream away like torn banners. At its
foot a broad stair has been cut down into the living rock, its first
steps worn into shallow bowls. East, a heavy door of weathered planks is
set into the mountainside, and paths lead north and south across the
windswept shelf.

extra_descs.tooth spire fang black stone:
Close to, the Tooth is not smooth at all but ribbed and fluted by ages
of wind and ice, its black stone glittering with flecks like frost. Old
dwarven runes are cut into its foot, too weathered to read but for one
deep sign shaped like a crown.

8531.name: The Old Cave

west.description: To the west lies Beside The Tooth Of The World.

8531.description:
Behind the weathered door a cave runs back into the mountain, its walls
rough and blackened by ancient smoke. Whoever once lived here is long
gone; the floor is scored with deep claw marks, and a heap of dry
bracken and shed fur fills the far corner where some great beast makes
its bed. A heavy, musky reek hangs in the still air. The only way out is
west, through the door to the windswept shelf beside the Tooth.

8532.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies Beside The Tooth Of The World.

8532.description:
The path runs along a knife-edged ridge here, with steep slopes of
shattered rock dropping away on either hand into misty hollows. Looking
back south, the black bulk of the Tooth fills half the sky; ahead, the
ridge carries the path north toward lower, rounder heights. Little
cairns of three or four stones mark the safest line along the crest.

8533.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8533.description:
A long, level ledge runs across the face of the mountain, wide enough
for two to walk abreast, with a sheer wall on one side and a steep drop
on the other. Far below, a dark glimmer of water marks a mountain tarn
cupped in the rocks. The path follows the ledge east and west, and the
wall above is streaked with the tracks of old snowslides.

8534.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

8534.description:
Beneath an overhanging crag streaked with black water stains, the path
turns a sharp corner. Icicles hang from the crag's lip in a ragged
fringe, dripping steadily onto the stones and freezing again into lumpy
pillars. A hollow under the overhang has been used as a shelter, its
floor blackened by old fires. The way runs north up a slope of tilted
slate and east along the foot of the mountain.

8535.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8535.description:
Broken slabs of slate lie tilted every which way across this slope, like
the roof of some giant's house fallen in. The path threads between them,
going north toward a ledge above a dark cleft and south down the slope,
while a fainter track wanders off west. Patches of old snow lie in the
slabs' shadows, crusted hard and grey.

8536.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

8536.description:
A faint track wanders across a slope of coarse grass and frost-shattered
stones, where the mountain's bones show through its thin skin of earth.
A trickle of water runs in a groove beside the path, freezing at its
edges into lace. The track bends here, leading north around a jutting
spur and east toward the slope of tilted slates.

8537.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

8537.description:
The path rounds a spur of the mountain on a ledge of crumbling shale,
with handholds worn into the rock face. Beyond the spur the land opens
into a wide view of peaks and cloud, with snowfields gleaming on the
highest summits. East, the ledge leads toward an iron ring above a dark
cleft, and south it drops along a grassy slope.

8538.name: In The Mountains

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

down.description: To the down lies Hanging On A Rope.

8538.description:
A ledge of flat rock juts over a dark cleft here, and an iron ring as
thick as a wrist is hammered into the stone at its edge, with a knotted
rope tied fast to it and hanging down into the depths. Paths lead away
south along a broken slope and west around a shoulder of the mountain.
The wind moans across the mouth of the cleft like breath over a jug.

8539.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies At The Entrance To A Cave.

8539.description:
Here the mountains begin to fall away, and a stony track drops west
toward rolling foothills where a lone peak hides a dark cave mouth in
its flank. The ridge path climbs back south toward the Tooth, and
another way winds east deeper among the heights. Sheep trails thread the
lower slopes, and the wind carries the smell of grass up from the hills.

8540.name: Hanging On A Rope

up.description: To the up lies In The Mountains.

down.description: To the down lies Entrance To The Shortcut.

8540.description:
You dangle on a knotted rope halfway down a sheer cleft in the
mountainside, your boots scrabbling for purchase on wet rock. Above, the
rope runs up to an iron ring hammered into a ledge under a strip of grey
sky; below, it vanishes down a shaft into darkness, toward the mouth of
a hewn tunnel. The wind sets the rope swaying, and small stones rattle
past you into the gloom.

8541.name: Entrance To The Shortcut

north.description: To the north lies In The Shortcut.

up.description: To the up lies Hanging On A Rope.

8541.description:
A tall shaft rises here through the rock to a far-off patch of daylight,
and a knotted rope hangs down its middle, swaying gently in the draught.
The rope's lowest knot dangles just above a floor of fitted stones,
where a hewn passage begins and runs north into the dark. Water trickles
down the shaft's walls and gathers in a shallow pool beneath the rope.

extra_descs.rope knotted hemp:
The rope is thick hemp, tarred black and knotted at every arm's length,
and it is newer than it looks. Someone keeps it in good repair.

8542.name: In The Shortcut

north.description: To the north lies In The Shortcut.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Shortcut.

8542.description:
The passage runs dead straight through the rock here, its walls scored
with the parallel grooves of chisels and picks. Water drips from the
ceiling and trickles away along a gutter cut beside the floor, the only
sound in the darkness besides your breathing. Soot stains above small
niches in the wall show where lamps once burned. The tunnel continues
north and south.

8543.name: In The Shortcut

north.description: To the north lies In The Small Cave.

south.description: To the south lies In The Shortcut.

west.description: To the west lies In The Shortcut.

8543.description:
The shortcut is a passage hewn through the mountain's roots, just tall
enough to walk upright, with a floor of flat stones fitted together like
a cellar's. Three ways meet here: north to a small natural cave, south
along the straight hewn passage, and west into a narrower bore. A crude
arrow scratched in chalk on the wall points north, toward a faint grey
light.

8544.name: In The Shortcut

north.description: To the north lies In The Shortcut.

east.description: To the east lies In The Shortcut.

8544.description:
The bore is narrower here, and the ceiling dips so low that you must
stoop to pass, your shoulders brushing walls of cold, sweating stone.
Someone has cut a small mark at head height, a circle split by a single
line, perhaps a miner's sign. The passage runs north into the darkness
and east toward a meeting of ways.

8545.name: In The Shortcut

east.description: To the east lies In The Small Cave.

south.description: To the south lies In The Shortcut.

up.description: To the up lies In The Western Foothills.

8545.description:
A slanting shaft climbs up from the roof of the passage here, fitted
with iron rungs that lead toward a glimmer of daylight and a breath of
grassy air. The hewn tunnel bends south into darkness, while an opening
east leads into the rough walls of a small natural cave. Roots have
found their way down the shaft, hanging like pale strings beside the
rungs.

8546.name: In The Small Cave

south.description: To the south lies In The Shortcut.

west.description: To the west lies In The Shortcut.

up.description: To the up lies Near The Northern Chasm.

8546.description:
This is a small, rough cave, its walls glistening with damp and its
floor heaped with rubble fallen from the roof. A shaft of grey daylight
slants down through a hole above, where the way climbs up to the open
mountainside. Two passages leave the cave, one south and one west, both
squared off by tools and running away into darkness.

8547.name: Near The Northern Chasm

north.description: To the north lies The Corner Of The Northern Chasm.

down.description: To the down lies In The Small Cave.

8547.description:
This stony shelf lies a stone's throw from the lip of the Northern
Chasm, close enough to feel the cold breath rising from its depths. In
the middle of the shelf a black hole opens in the rock, just wide enough
for a body to squeeze through, and a draught of damp air sighs up out of
it. The way down leads into the hole, and north the ground rises to the
corner of the chasm.

8548.name: In The Western Foothills

north.description: To the north lies In The Western Foothills.

down.description: To the down lies In The Shortcut.

8548.description:
Grassy hummocks roll away on every side, dotted with grey boulders and
clumps of yellow gorse. Half hidden in a fold of the hill, a narrow hole
ringed with iron rungs leads down into the dark beneath the mountains. A
sheep track winds north between the hillocks, and the mountains loom
close behind, their lower slopes purple with heather.

8549.name: In The Western Foothills

north.description: To the north lies In The Western Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies In The Western Foothills.

8549.description:
The foothills fold and dip here like a rumpled blanket, and the path
runs along the bottom of a shallow green trough. A tiny brook trickles
beside it through beds of watercress and rushes. Sheep have cropped the
grass short, and tufts of their wool hang on every thorn. The way leads
north up a rise crowned by a lone hawthorn and south toward a hidden
hole in a fold of the hillside.

8550.name: In The Western Foothills

north.description: To the north lies The Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies In The Western Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies In The Western Foothills.

8550.description:
The path tops a rise where a lone hawthorn grows, bent almost double by
the wind, its branches combed out to one side. North, a path runs on
through low hills toward the open foothills; south, it drops back into a
green trough; and west a fainter track wanders off among the hillocks.
From here the mountains stand in a great wall, grey above and green
below.

8551.name: In The Western Foothills

north.description: To the north lies At The End Of The Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies In The Western Foothills.

8551.description:
The hills grow steeper and rockier here, and the grass gives way to
bracken and outcrops of weathered grey stone. An old dry-stone wall,
tumbled in places, wanders across the slope and vanishes over a crest.
The track leads north toward the last of the foothills and east toward a
lone hawthorn on a rise.

8552.name: At The End Of The Foothills

south.description: To the south lies In The Western Foothills.

8552.description:
The foothills end abruptly at the foot of a sheer mountain wall, a cliff
of pale stone that rises without crack or ledge for hundreds of feet.
Boulders that have fallen from it lie half sunk in the turf, furred with
moss. There is no way on, and the only path leads back south among the
hills. Water weeps down the cliff face in dark streaks, and the air here
is cold and still.

8553.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies The Sharp Turn.

south.description: To the south lies The Corner Of The Northern Chasm.

8553.description:
The path climbs steeply among jagged teeth of rock, some taller than a
house and leaning at drunken angles. Frost has split many of them open,
and their broken faces gleam with fresh, sharp edges. South, the path
drops back toward the corner of the chasm, and north it squeezes on
between the stones toward a sharp bend.

8554.name: The Sharp Turn

east.description: To the east lies The Small Plateau.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

8554.description:
The path doubles back on itself around a blind shoulder of rock, so
sharply that you must turn sideways to edge past. A sheer drop yawns at
the outer side of the bend, and the rock face is polished smooth by
countless hands groping for a grip. The way leads east onto open ground,
and south back down among the jagged stones.

8555.name: The Small Plateau

west.description: To the west lies The Sharp Turn.

down.description: To the down lies In The Gorge.

8555.description:
A flat table of rock no bigger than a village green sits among the
peaks, carpeted with short, springy turf and tiny white flowers. The
wind sweeps across it unhindered, and the view is immense: range upon
range of mountains, and far away the dim green of lowland forest. At its
edge a steep path drops down into a dark gorge, and the sharp turn lies
back west.

8556.name: In The Gorge

up.description: To the up lies The Small Plateau.

down.description: To the down lies In The Gorge.

8556.description:
The gorge is a deep, narrow slot in the mountain, its walls rising so
high that the sky is no more than a pale crack overhead. A torrent once
ran here, and its bed is a staircase of smooth boulders down which the
path picks its way. The way climbs up toward the plateau's light and
drops down deeper into shadow.

8557.name: In The Gorge

up.description: To the up lies In The Gorge.

down.description: To the down lies Before The Mountains.

8557.description:
Ferns and dripping moss crowd the walls of the lower gorge, fed by
springs that seep from the rock and patter onto the stones. The air is
damp and still after the high winds, and every sound echoes back twice.
Downward the gorge widens and lets in more light, opening onto greener
country, while the boulder stair climbs back up into the gloom.

8558.name: Before The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies Mountain Trail.

up.description: To the up lies In The Gorge.

8558.description:
The gorge opens here onto grassy hills at the very foot of the
mountains, and the grey wall of the range rises behind like a fortress.
Heather and gorse cover the slopes, and a stream from the gorge chuckles
away through the grass. A well-worn trail sets off east along the
mountainside, and the gorge climbs up into the rock.

8559.name: The Corner Of The Northern Chasm

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies At The Edge Of The Chasm.

south.description: To the south lies Near The Northern Chasm.

8559.description:
The Northern Chasm turns a sharp corner here, its two arms meeting in a
vast pit of shadow from which a cold wind rises without ceasing. A path
follows the rim east, while another leaves the edge and climbs north
among jagged rocks. South, the ground slopes down to a stony shelf near
the lip, where a dark hole opens in the rock.

8560.name: At The Edge Of The Chasm

east.description: To the east lies The Edge Of The Chasm.

west.description: To the west lies The Corner Of The Northern Chasm.

8560.description:
A spur of rock juts out over the chasm here, and from its tip a ribbon
of white water can be seen glinting at the bottom, impossibly far below.
Someone has driven an iron stake into the spur and tied a rope to it,
though the rope ends a few feet down in a frayed and ragged stump. The
rim path runs on east, and west it bends toward a corner where the chasm
turns.

8561.name: The Edge Of The Chasm

east.description: To the east lies The Edge Of The Chasm.

west.description: To the west lies At The Edge Of The Chasm.

8561.description:
A narrow path runs along the chasm's edge, squeezed between the abyss on
one hand and a rising slope of loose scree on the other. Here and there
a stunted juniper clings to the very brink, its roots gripping the stone
like fingers. The path continues east and west along the rim, and the
wind rising from below smells of wet rock and moss.

8562.name: The Edge Of The Chasm

east.description: To the east lies The Edge Of The Chasm.

south.description: To the south lies Vulture Hill.

west.description: To the west lies The Edge Of The Chasm.

8562.description:
The world simply stops here: the ground ends at the brink of a chasm so
deep that its floor is lost in blue shadow and drifting mist. A cold
updraft breathes from the depths, carrying the faint roar of water far
below. Paths follow the rim east and west, and a way south climbs a
bald, white-splashed hill.

8563.name: The Edge Of The Chasm

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies The Edge Of The Chasm.

8563.description:
The rim of the chasm curves here, and the path along it crumbles where
the edge has broken away in great bites. Across the gulf, sheer cliffs
of banded rock catch the light, striped red, grey and ochre like the
layers of a cake. The way runs back west along the brink, and a safer
path turns south away from the edge into a fold of the mountains.

8564.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies The Edge Of The Chasm.

east.description: To the east lies The Hideaway.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

8564.description:
A fold in the mountainside shelters this spot from the wind, and snow
lies deep in drifts against a sheer rock face. Set into that face, so
cunningly that it is easy to miss, is a stout door of planks painted the
grey of the stone around it, leading east into the mountain. Paths lead
north toward the chasm's rim and south along the foot of the cliff.

8565.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

8565.description:
The path ends in a cramped hollow walled in by cliffs, where the snow
has drifted chest-deep against the rock. Nothing grows here but a few
clumps of frost-blackened heather. Rows of short scratches mark the rock
at shoulder height, as though someone once counted days here. The only
way out is back north along the foot of the cliff, and the silence is so
deep you can hear your own heart.

8566.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies The Hermit's Stone.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8566.description:
A wide, wind-scoured shelf runs across the mountainside here, strewn
with frost-split stones. South, a single enormous boulder sits alone at
the end of a spur, and a worn path leads out to it; west, the shelf runs
back toward a crossing of trails. A narrower way leads north between two
cliffs into a snow-choked hollow.

8567.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies Vulture Hill.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies Mountain Trail.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8567.description:
Four trails meet in this windswept hollow, and a tall standing stone
marks the crossing, its faces worn smooth by the weather. North, a bald
hill rises against the sky, its crown splashed white; south, a well-
trodden trail descends along the mountainside. Other paths wander east
among the peaks and west down a high, grassy valley.

extra_descs.standing stone arrows:
Faint arrows have been scratched into each face of the stone, one for
every trail. Beside the arrow that points toward the bald hill, someone
