has added the rough shape of a bird with its wings spread wide.

8568.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8568.description:
A high valley runs between two ridges here, floored with tough grey
grass and boulders spotted with lichen. Snowmelt has cut a shallow
channel down its length, dry now and paved with rounded stones. Among
the boulders stand the walls of a shepherd's hut, roofless and half
fallen. The way leads east toward a meeting of trails and west to where
the mountains drop toward the foothills.

8569.name: Vulture Hill

north.description: To the north lies The Edge Of The Chasm.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

8569.description:
The hill is a bare dome of rock, its crown splashed white with the
droppings of carrion birds. A dead pine stands at the summit, stripped
of bark and bleached grey, its branches worn smooth where heavy talons
grip. The smell of old carrion lingers in the hollows. North, the ground
ends abruptly at the lip of a vast chasm, and south the slope runs down
to a meeting of trails.

8570.name: The Hideaway

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Sanctum.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

8570.description:
Behind the hidden door lies a long, low room hollowed out of the rock,
warmer than the mountainside and smelling of tallow and old smoke. Bunks
of rough timber line the walls, and a trestle table scarred with knife
cuts stands before a hearth whose smoke escapes through a crack in the
ceiling. A second door, bound with iron, leads east deeper into the
rock, and the way out is west.

8571.name: The Inner Sanctum

west.description: To the west lies The Hideaway.

8571.description:
This small inner chamber is cut with more care than the room beyond, its
walls smoothed and its corners squared. A heavy chair carved from a
single block of stone sits against the far wall like a throne, and
beside it an iron strongbox is bolted to the floor. Maps and lists of
names have been scratched into the plaster in a cramped hand. The only
door leads back west.

extra_descs.maps names plaster scratches lists:
The maps show the mountain trails in crude lines, with small marks at
the cliff camp, along the chasm's rim and at the road far below. Beside
them runs a long column of names, most of them struck through.

8572.name: The Hermit's Stone

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

8572.description:
A boulder as big as a cottage sits alone at the end of this spur,
dropped here by some ancient ice and left balanced on the very brink of
a drop. Beneath its overhang a hollow has been scraped out and walled
with piled stones, and a weathered inscription is cut into the boulder's
face above it. The view from here is vast and lonely. The only way back
is north along the spur.

extra_descs.inscription words boulder letters:
The letters are cut deep but softened by long weather. They read: Here I
sat, and the mountains taught me patience; they have not finished
teaching. Beneath the words a small open hand has been carved into the
stone.

9800.name: Mountain Trail

east.description: To the east lies Mountain Trail.

west.description: To the west lies Before The Mountains.

9800.description:
The trail begins its long climb here, a rutted path of packed earth and
stone scratched along the flank of the mountains. Below it the slope
falls away in grassy folds to the hills; above, grey cliffs stack one
upon another into the clouds. West, the trail drops to the grassy ground
before the mountains, and east it rises steadily on.

9801.name: Mountain Trail

east.description: To the east lies Mountain Trail.

west.description: To the west lies Mountain Trail.

9801.description:
The trail crosses a long slope of scree on a path of flat stones laid by
some careful hand long ago, most of them still in place. A rusted iron
post leans at the outer edge, all that remains of a railing. The way
climbs on east and slopes back west, and now and then loose stones
rattle down from the heights above.

9802.name: Mountain Trail

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies Near the Mountain's Peak.

west.description: To the west lies Mountain Trail.

9802.description:
A side path branches off the mountain trail here, climbing north into
the high country toward a meeting of ways. The main trail goes on east,
rising toward a peak whose summit is hidden in cloud, and west it drops
back toward the foothills. A worn milestone stands at the fork, its
carved letters long since erased by frost.

9803.name: Near the Mountain's Peak

east.description: To the east lies Trail to the Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Mountain Trail.

9803.description:
The trail reaches its highest point here, skirting just below a summit
of shattered rock wrapped in cloud. Freezing mist drifts across the
path, beading on your cloak and hair, and the air is so thin that every
step is an effort. East, the trail begins its descent toward a valley;
west, it runs back down along the mountainside.

9804.name: Trail to the Valley

east.description: To the east lies In the Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Near the Mountain's Peak.

9804.description:
The trail winds downward in long loops, and with every turn the air
grows a little warmer and the rocks give way to tough grass and
bilberry. Below, a green valley opens among the mountains, thick with
trees and threaded by a stream. The trail descends east toward it and
climbs west back toward the cloud-capped peak.

9805.name: In the Valley

east.description: To the east lies In a Clearing.

west.description: To the west lies Trail to the Valley.

9805.description:
Tall pines and silver birches fill the valley floor, and after the bare
heights their shade feels close and green. A clear stream runs beside
the path over pebbles of every colour, and the air smells of resin and
wet earth. The path climbs west out of the trees toward the mountain
trail, and east the woods thin toward a patch of open sky.

9806.name: In a Clearing

west.description: To the west lies In the Valley.

down.description: To the down lies A Stairwell.

9806.description:
The trees draw back around a quiet clearing where long grass grows over
the tumbled stones of some ancient wall. In the middle, set into a ring
of mossy masonry, is a square trapdoor of oak bound with black iron, and
a way leads down through it into darkness. The woods close in on every
side but the west, where a path leads back into the valley.

extra_descs.trapdoor masonry ring:
The ring of masonry is the top of a round stone tower, buried in the
earth up to its battlements, and the trapdoor sits where its roof should
be. Letters worn almost smooth run around the rim, and the clearest of
them spell out a single name: RAND.

4000.name: snake
4000.long_desc: A large dreadful snake is at your feet, hissing at you.

4001.name: snake
4001.long_desc: A small green snake is here, and it doesn't look too friendly...

4002.name: centipede
4002.long_desc: A small centipede is here, making its way across the floor.

4003.name: kobold
4003.long_desc: An ugly kobold is here, searching for dinner.

4004.name: orc
4004.long_desc: The orc walks around, looking for someone to kill.
4004.description: You notice an evil look in its eyes...

4005.name: orc
4005.long_desc: A large orc is here, looking really mean.

4050.name: warrior
4050.long_desc: A tall warrior is here.  He has more scars than anyone you have ever seen.
4050.description: He seems to be a strong, brainless fighter.

4051.name: warrior
4051.description: He seems to know his way with weapons.

4054.name: centipede
4054.description: The centipede doesn't really seem to notice you.

4056.name: orc
4056.long_desc: An orc is here, looking for something (or perhaps someone?) to eat.
4056.description: Well, he doesn't seem to be friendly.

4057.name: lion
4057.long_desc: A mountain lion is here, growling at you viciously.
4057.description: The lion looks very nasty with huge claws and big teeth.

4058.name: giant
4058.long_desc: A hill giant is here, tossing some rocks around.
4058.description:
The hill giant looks like he's about 9 feet tall.  By his actions you 
quickly come to the conclusion that he isn't very intelligent.

4100.name: mage
4100.long_desc: A small intelligent looking mage is standing here.
4100.description:
His IQ makes almost any normal person look stupid...
It looks like he knows his way with magic.

4101.name: troll
4101.long_desc: A large mean-looking troll is here.

4102.name: snake
4102.long_desc: A large green snake is here, looks like a guardian for an evil force.

4103.name: thief
4103.long_desc: A thief is here, all dressed in black.
4103.description:
He seems to be counting a handful of coins.  Maybe you ought to count YOUR
gold too...

4104.name: orc
4104.long_desc: A ugly orc is standing here.
4104.description: It is quite disgusting to look at.

4105.name: centipede
4105.long_desc: A small harmless centipede is here.
4105.description: Well it doesn't seem to pay any attention to you.

4106.name: warrior
4106.long_desc: A human warrior is here.  He has a evil grin in his face.
4106.description: He doesn't look friendly at all...

4098.name: dwarven miner
4098.long_desc: A grizzled dwarven miner sits here, resting against a collapsed tunnel wall.
4098.description: His beard is caked with dust and his hands are raw from pickaxe work. His eyes dart nervously toward the deeper tunnels whenever a sound echoes from below.

talk_responses.hello: The miner wipes sweat from his brow. 'Don't go deeper than you have to, friend. I've been hearing sounds from below — not cave-ins, something worse. Rhythmic, like drums... or footsteps. Big ones.'
talk_responses.danger: The miner shudders. 'The snakes down here are bad enough, but there are darker things in the deep tunnels. Stick to the lit passages if you value your skin.'
talk_responses.default: The miner grunts. 'Watch your step. These tunnels have a way of swallowing folk whole.'
talk_responses.next: The miner spits on the ground. 'You handle yourself well down here. The city of Thalos to the east could use capable fighters. Or if you're brave enough, the Drow lurk in their underground city far below. The sewers beneath Garathorm also hide nastier things than rats, if you catch my drift.'

4099.name: lost adventurer
4099.long_desc: A wounded adventurer leans against the wall here, nursing a bandaged arm.
4099.description: She's young, barely out of her teens, with a dented shield and a sword notched beyond repair. Her eyes have the hollow look of someone who's seen too much down here.

talk_responses.hello: The adventurer winces. 'Turn back if you can. The snakes in the tunnels have venom that'll drop you before you can scream. And further down... I saw shapes moving in the dark. Dozens of them.'
talk_responses.snakes: She grips her bandaged arm. 'Poison. Got me through a gap in my armor. Carry antidotes if you have them — the green ones are the worst.'
talk_responses.default: The adventurer stares blankly. 'I just want to find the way out...'

604000.name: mountain goat billy shaggy
604000.long_desc: A shaggy mountain goat picks its way along the rocks, utterly unbothered by the drop.
604000.description:
A sturdy billy goat with a coat of long, dirty-white hair that hangs in
a fringe over its legs, and a pair of black horns curving back from its
brow. Its yellow eyes, with their odd oblong pupils, regard you with
mild contempt as it chews. A frayed leather collar hangs loose about its
neck, as though it once belonged to some foothill herder.

604001.name: hawk bird mountain brown
604001.long_desc: A mountain hawk perches on a jut of rock, its fierce gold eyes following your every move.
604001.description:
It is a big, broad-winged hawk, brown above and barred with cream below,
its hooked beak dark as horn. When the wind gusts it half opens its
wings and rides the air without effort, then settles again with a ruffle
of feathers. Its long tail feathers, banded brown and grey, are the kind
fletchers prize.

604002.name: rock spider grey giant
604002.long_desc: A grey rock spider the size of a hound clings motionless to the wall, nearly invisible against the stone.
604002.description:
Its body is mottled grey and brown exactly like the rock it lives on,
and its eight jointed legs bristle with stiff hairs that let it cling to
the smoothest wall. A cluster of small black eyes glitters above a pair
of hooked fangs wet with clear venom. Fine silk lines laid along the
floor tremble at the slightest touch, warning it of anything that
passes.

604003.name: cave bear great brown
604003.long_desc: A great cave bear rears up out of the gloom, swinging its massive head toward you.
604003.description:
It is far larger than any forest bear, with a high, humped shoulder and
a broad, flat-browed skull. Its brown coat is matted and scarred, and
its claws, each as long as a dagger, click on the stone when it moves.
Its small dark eyes smoulder with slow, sullen anger at being disturbed.

4000.name: ring
4000.room_desc: A ring is here, with yellow and green ornamentation.  It looks very old.

4001.name: miner's pickaxe
4001.description: A sturdy pickaxe used in the mines.

4002.room_desc: A miner's iron helmet lies here.

4053.room_desc: A beautifully crafted dirk is lying here.

4100.room_desc: A black demon blade is here.

4101.name: gloves
4101.room_desc: A pair of finely crafted gloves are lying on the ground here.

4102.name: scroll
4102.room_desc: A scroll which reads 'ysafg', it looks very fragile and quite old.

4103.name: slime
4103.room_desc: A green slime mould is here.  Stinks like you wouldn't believe!

4104.room_desc: A green slime mould is here.  Stinks like you wouldn't believe!

4120.name: a moria delver's notes
4120.room_desc: A bundle of notes is tucked into a stone niche.
4120.description: Careful handwriting maps the lower tunnels.
4120.lore_text: "The mithril vein sings when the mountain shifts. We marked it with chimes."

4121.name: a foreman's ledger
4121.room_desc: A worn ledger rests beside the strongbox.
4121.description: The pages are thick with soot and numbers.
4121.lore_text: "Three crews missing. The deep shaft is sealed until the chimes are silent."

4122.name: a mithril shard
4122.room_desc: A gleaming mithril shard lies among the rubble.
4122.description: Light dances across its silvery surface.

4123.name: an ironbound strongbox
4123.description: Its lock is engraved with a pickaxe symbol.

4124.name: a foreman's key
4124.room_desc: A heavy key hangs from a hook.
4124.description: The key is stamped with a dwarven sigil.

4125.name: an echo stone
4125.room_desc: A smooth stone hums softly here.
4125.description: When held, it vibrates with distant echoes.

4095.name: stone signpost
4095.room_desc: A sturdy dwarven stone marker is set into the cave wall.
4095.readable_text:

Recommended Level: 8-15
WARNING: Goblins and cave creatures infest these tunnels
Seek Grimjaw the Prospector for work
Deeper levels (Level 15+) lie below

4004.short_desc: a pair of miner's thick gloves

704000.name: trinket goat horn charm thong
704000.room_desc: A small trinket of carved goat horn lies here on a frayed leather thong.
704000.description: A thumb-length curl of goat horn, carved with a ring of tiny hoofprints and polished smooth by long wear, hangs from a frayed leather thong. Foothill herders tie such charms to their lead goats to keep them sure-footed on the heights, and the goats that ran wild on the mountain sometimes still wear them.

704001.name: feathers hawk sheaf barred
704001.short_desc: a sheaf of barred hawk feathers
704001.room_desc: A sheaf of brown-and-cream hawk feathers lies here, stirring in the draught.
704001.description: A handful of long wing and tail feathers, barred brown and cream, stiff in the shaft and perfectly whole. A fletcher would pay well for them, for arrows fletched with mountain hawk are said to fly true even in a crosswind.

704002.name: pick prospector rock hammer
704002.room_desc: A prospector's rock pick lies here, its haft wrapped in old grey cobweb.
704002.description: A short, heavy pick with a squared hammer face on one side of the head and a narrow spike on the other, made for splitting stone to see what lies within. The ash haft is darkened by the grip of some long-gone miner's hands, and strands of old web still cling to it.
